reviews.text: Dog daycare and hotel, the staff are very friendly!!

I love Distrito Canino because they have a suitable area and the perfect size for dogs to enjoy comfortably. The staff is excellent, always attentive and caring. Without a doubt, an ideal place for our four-legged friends. 🤍🐶 …
For the past 6 years, my dogs have been bathed, spent in daycare and boarding at Distrito Canino, and they are always very well cared for. They go happily to Distrito Canino, and I recommend it 100%.
Excellent hotel and daycare. My dog ​​is happy.

I've been taking Fifi to their daycare and hotel for almost four years now, and it's always been an excellent experience. She has a wonderful time; you can tell they care for her with love, and they're very kind and attentive. They genuinely care about her well-being. I highly recommend them; knowing she's in good hands gives me peace of mind, and I can focus on my activities with confidence.

The best care for owners and pets! My dogs have been going there for 8 years and they've always been incredibly well cared for, and they go with great joy. They're always attentive to any changes in their behavior, and thanks to that, we've been able to detect any health issues early and start treatment.
We've been with Distrito Canino for 5 years now, starting with my female dog, and 3 years later with my male dog. The transport service is good, they have a veterinarian and treat them very well.
